Apple scab.cause: Fungal infection caused by Venturia inaequalis
Apple scab.symptoms: Dark olive-green spots on leaves, eventually turning brown and scabby, deformed fruits

Apple Black rot.symptoms: Brown circular lesions on leaves, black rotting fruit, cankers on branches

Cedar apple rust.symptoms: Bright orange-yellow spots on upper leaf surface, tube-like growths underneath

Blueberry healthy.symptoms: Plant appears healthy with no visible symptoms

Cherry Powdery mildew.symptoms: White powdery coating on young leaves and shoots, distorted growth

Cercospora leaf spot Gray leaf spot.symptoms: Rectangular grey-tan lesions between leaf veins, lesions turn tan with yellow halo

Common rust.symptoms: Small oval pustules with powdery reddish-brown spores on both leaf surfaces

Northern Leaf Blight.symptoms: Long greyish-green cigar-shaped lesions on corn leaves, tan centres

Grape Black rot.symptoms: Brown circular leaf lesions with black border, shrivelled black mummified fruit

Esca (Black Measles).cause: Complex of fungal pathogens including Phaeomoniella chlamydospora
Esca (Black Measles).symptoms: Interveinal chlorosis and necrosis on leaves, dark streaking in wood, berry spotting

Leaf blight (Isariopsis Leaf Spot).symptoms: Dark brown angular lesions on leaves, lesions coalesce causing leaf drop

Haunglongbing (Citrus greening).cause: Bacterial infection by Candidatus Liberibacter, spread by Asian citrus psyllid
Haunglongbing (Citrus greening).symptoms: Asymmetric yellowing of leaves, stunted growth, misshapen bitter fruit

Peach Bacterial spot.cause: Bacterial infection by Xanthomonas arboricola pv. pruni
Peach Bacterial spot.symptoms: Small water-soaked spots on leaves turning brown, shot-hole appearance, fruit lesions

Pepper Bacterial spot.cause: Bacterial infection by Xanthomonas campestris pv. vesicatoria
Pepper Bacterial spot.symptoms: Small water-soaked lesions on leaves, raised scab-like spots on fruit

Potato Early blight.symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings on lower leaves, yellow halo around spots

Potato Late blight.symptoms: Dark water-soaked lesions on leaves and stems, white mold on underside in humid conditions

Squash Powdery mildew.cause: Fungal pathogens Podosphaera xanthii or Erysiphe cichoracearum
Squash Powdery mildew.symptoms: White powdery spots on leaves and stems, yellowing and premature leaf drop

Strawberry Leaf scorch.symptoms: Small dark purple spots on upper leaf surface, centres turn greyish-brown

Tomato Bacterial spot.symptoms: Small water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit, spots turn brown with yellow halo

Tomato Early blight.symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric target-like rings, starts on older lower leaves

Tomato Late blight.symptoms: Greasy grey-green water-soaked patches on leaves, white mold on undersides

Leaf Mold.cause: Fungal infection by Passalora fulva (formerly Cladosporium fulvum)
Leaf Mold.symptoms: Pale green to yellow spots on upper leaf surface, olive-green mold on underside

Septoria leaf spot.symptoms: Small circular spots with dark brown border and grey centre, tiny black dots inside spots

Spider mites Two-spotted spider mite.symptoms: Tiny yellow or white speckles on leaves, fine webbing on underside, bronzing of leaves

Target Spot.symptoms: Brown circular lesions with concentric rings resembling a target, affects leaves and fruit

Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.cause: Virus transmitted by whitefly Bemisia tabaci
Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.symptoms: Yellowing and upward curling of leaves, stunted plant growth, reduced fruit set

Tomato mosaic virus.cause: Tomato mosaic virus (ToMV) spread by contact and contaminated tools
Tomato mosaic virus.symptoms: Mosaic pattern of light and dark green on leaves, distorted fruit, stunted growth

healthy.symptoms: Plant appears healthy with no visible symptoms
